interpretation.repair_backed_duplicate: The report maps to a repaired cause represented by another report in the 264-report cohort.
interpretation.repair_backed_primary: The report has a complete implemented-relation-to-landed-repair chain.
interpretation.reviewed_no_traceable_landed_repair: The report remains in the confirmed in-scope cohort, but the collected public evidence does not identify a landed repair that completes the causal chain.

scope_note: These counts measure documentary causal-reconstruction coverage within the confirmed 264-report cohort. They do not estimate bug prevalence.
